title: Hoy2024 effort decision LFP: subthalamic/pallidal and prefrontal recordings during an effort-based decision task (DBS surgery)
description: Intraoperative local field potential recordings from the subthalamic nucleus or globus pallidus internus and from prefrontal cortex (frontopolar or orbitofrontal) in five patients undergoing deep brain stimulation surgery while performing an effort-based decision-making task. The derivative BIDS release contains preprocessed, epoched bipolar signals with trial-level behavioural and model variables, together with continuous raw neural exports. The data support analyses of beta and theta oscillations related to effort and previous reward during decision making.
methods_description: Bipolar LFP signals were recorded intraoperatively at 422 or 500 Hz during an effort-based decision task. Preprocessed FieldTrip epochs span -2 to 9 s around the offer, with per-trial behavioural fields (effort, stake, decision, reaction time, model-derived values) stored as events. Continuous raw exports were repackaged into BrainVision format.
